title: DashLens - Dashboard Warning Light Co-Driver
tagline: Point your phone at the dashboard, ask what a light means, and get the answer from your car's own owner's manual, hands-free.
description: A hands-free Android voice and camera assistant built on Agora Conversational AI. A vision LLM reads the live RTC camera frame, HTTP tool calls fetch the car's owner's manual and verified roadside helpline, and silent screen tags drive a stop card with one-tap dialling when a lamp is urgent.
author: Shubh Singh
